chunks: So remind; you are but a reminder.
ai.seo_question: What is the specific role of the Prophet as a 'reminder' according to Surah Al-Ghashiyah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the theological foundation for the Imams' infallibility and role as perfect conveyors of divine truth, distinguishing their duty of clear proclamation (tabligh) from the ultimate bestowal of guidance (tawfiq) by God. It underscores that while the Prophet and Imams are responsible for delivering the message with clarity, the acceptance of that message remains contingent upon divine will and human free will, a concept central to understanding the nature of prophetic and imamic authority.
